skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: Hand of Destiny
skins.content: Witch Feast Role-Playing Script 'Dominions & Dogma' Custom Line/Hand of Destiny. This player shall be the will of the realm behind the story. She is neither a wicked god, nor a righteous spirit. All she does is let the players roll the dice.
skins.quote: This is not the first time Dorothy has taken on the role of the lord of the realm. To weave a fantasy, to direct an adventure, to achieve everyone else's hopes and dreams... She has always been like this.
